description: Build the member's Applystead personal website (needs an Applystead membership) with the member's own agent: write and delete the draft's text files (html, htm, css, json, txt, xml, svg, md and webmanifest), publish the draft, and connect or disconnect their own domain. Images are added in the app, not written as files. Sites are static HTML and CSS with no scripts: pages may not run scripts (<script>, on...= attributes, javascript: links), ask for passwords or hold forms, redirect, or embed frames or other pages; such files are refused with a message saying what to change. Spends no points. Actions: write_file, delete_file, publish, connect_domain, disconnect_domain. Call with action "help" for each action's fields.

params.description: Fields for the action. Call with action "help" to list each action's fields.

name: manage_website
title: Build website
